description: This file is a Python script implementing a FastAPI-based CLI tool for translating documentation pages, managing translations, and automating GitHub pull requests related to translation updates. It utilizes libraries such as Typer, GitPython, and PyGithub, indicating its purpose for automation and content management within a codebase.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: A class imported from pydantic_ai used to interact with OpenAI's language models, used here for generating translations based on prompts.

methods.name: Path generate_lang_path(*, lang: str, path: Path)
methods.description: Generates the path for a translated language file based on source paths.

methods.name: Path generate_en_path(*, lang: str, path: Path)
methods.description: Generates the path for the English source file from a translated language file.

methods.name: None translate_page( *, language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")], en_path: Annotated[Path, typer.Option(envvar="EN_PATH")], )
methods.description: CLI command function that manages content translation from English to a target language, using an AI agent.

methods.name: Iterable[Path] iter_all_en_paths()
methods.description: Iterates through all English documentation Markdown files in an ordered priority.

methods.name: Iterable[Path] iter_en_paths_to_translate()
methods.description: Filters the documentation files that require translation into a target language.

methods.name: list[str] list_llm_translatable()
methods.description: Lists supported languages for LLM-based translation, based on existing prompt files.

methods.name: None llm_translatable_json( language: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")] = None, )
methods.description: Outputs a JSON array of translatable languages, optionally filtering for a specific one.

methods.name: None commands_json( command: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="COMMAND")] = None, )
methods.description: Outputs a JSON array of available CLI commands, filtered if specified.

methods.name: list[Path] list_removable(language: str)
methods.description: Lists translated files in a language that can be removed because no English source exists.

methods.name: list[Path] list_all_removable()
methods.description: Lists all removable translation files across all supported languages.

methods.name: None remove_removable(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Deletes files identified as removable for a given language.

methods.name: None remove_all_removable()
methods.description: Deletes all removable files in all supported languages.

methods.name: list[Path] list_missing(language: str)
methods.description: Lists documentation files that are missing translations in a specific language.

methods.name: list[Path] list_outdated(language: str)
methods.description: Lists translated files that are outdated compared to the English source, based on commit timestamps.

methods.name: None update_outdated(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Re-translates outdated translation files to update them.

methods.name: None add_missing(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Translates and adds missing translation files.

methods.name: None update_and_add(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Performs both updating outdated and adding missing translation files.

methods.name: None make_pr( *, language: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")] = None, command: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="COMMAND")] = None, github_token: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="GITHUB_TOKEN")], github_repository: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="GITHUB_REPOSITORY")], commit_in_place: Annotated[ bool, typer.Option(envvar="COMMIT_IN_PLACE", show_default=True) ] = False, )
methods.description: Creates a GitHub pull request with updates to translations, handling branch creation, push, and PR creation.
